# neo_chat — Origin

## Source

**Original implementation by the MapSpatial-EvalKit authors**, written in the
integration style of the [VeOmni](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/VeOmni)
framework (Apache-2.0). No VeOmni code is copied.

The NEO-Chat architecture (NEOVisionModel + Qwen3 MoT backbone) follows the
official [OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-U1](https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-U1)
repository (Apache-2.0).
